culture.text: Runs upscale and lifestyle hotels, restaurants and event venues across Europe, including Park Plaza and art'otel.
Staff mostly studied hospitality, business or tourism, at schools like Hotelschool The Hague and UvA.
Describes a 'We Are Creators' culture built on connection, creativity and care, with structured learning.

growth.text: First-half 2026 revenue rose 4.7%, driven by strong UK performance.
Sold a Manhattan development site for US$33.5 million.

worth_knowing.text: Ended a formal sale process; the company stays independent and focuses on financial progress.
